subject: Req58 — hiring adjudication, compensation band review, and headcount reallocation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate update + ask for hiring committee slot (Req58)

Hi Karthik,

Quick update on Req58 (Senior Applied Infra Engineer) — we have a final round candidate, Alex Jeffries, who gave verbal interest in an offer yesterday. Feedback across interviewers is solid for match/impact but light on distributed systems scale experience.

I drafted an offer memo (attached) at the top of band 3 with a modest signing bonus to bridge the experience gap. Before I push for approval I need the hiring committee to adjudicate:
- Do we approve an offer at top of band 3 + $12k sign-on?
- If not, do we close the req and reallocate the headcount?

Attachments: req58-offer-memo.pdf, req58-eval.pdf

Can you loop in the committee or tell me if you want to take to the weekly hiring sync? Candidate has indicated they need a response within 10 business days.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: req58-offer-memo.pdf (1 page, proposed comp), req58-eval.pdf (interviewer notes)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate update + ask for hiring committee slot (Req58)

Forwarding Marissa's note — proposing we adjudicate offline rather than wait for the full sync because of the candidate timeline. My read after interviews: candidate is high upside on product infra work, but we lack confidence on large-scale sharding experience. Top of band 3 feels aggressive given risk.

My recommendation options (ranked):
1) Approve a conservative offer: mid-band 3, no sign-on, with a 9-month performance review for band bump if scale work shows up.
2) Close the req/no hire and reallocate headcount to IDS (Req66) which has clearer immediate impact on latency work.
3) Approve top-band + sign-on with strong hiring manager fallback (reduction right if milestones not met) — I don't favor this.

Requesting thumbs-up/decision by 11/3 EOD so we can respond within Marissa's window.

Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

On Oct 25, 2026, Marissa Cole wrote: (see above)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req58 adjudication — compensation band guidance

Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the context and the attachments. I reviewed the comp bands doc (attached) and the submitted interview feedback. A few notes:
- Req58 is currently scoped at Band 3 (senior). The published midpoint for band 3 is $220k base; top band moves into 235–240k depending on function.
- Given inconsistent large-scale experience and the risk profile described, authorizing top-band + sign-on would be an exception to policy and requires Exec approval.
- If the committee prefers to keep the hire within band policy, the conservative mid-band offer with a structured PIP/90–270 day performance evaluation is the compliant route.

Given current hiring velocity and the pipeline for infra work at Q4, HR's recommended path is to close this req and reassign headcount to a higher-priority node (Req66) unless the committee is comfortable taking an exception. Closing req58 preserves budget flexibility and avoids a difficult deviation.

Attachment: comp-bands-q4-2026.pdf

Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops (Compensation & Talent Programs)
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final adjudication — Req58 (No hire) and headcount reallocation

Team,

After reviewing the options and speaking briefly with Execs, the committee decision is: NO HIRE for Req58. Rationale: candidate fit is solid for product infra but not strong enough on distributed systems scale to justify a band exception; we need deterministic impact on latency and capacity work this quarter.

Action items:
- Marissa: politely close the loop with Alex, share constructive feedback, and remove the offer from ATS (complete by 11/06). Please attach interview notes for audit (use req58-eval.pdf).
- Karthik: submit a headcount reallocation request to Finance to move the position to Req66 (Platform IDS) with target start Q1 2027. Add a short rationale referencing throughput priorities.
- Laura: confirm no material comp spend committed; HR to record the closeout and mark req58 as closed in the headcount tracker.

I'll mark this resolved in the tracker. If anyone disagrees, flag within 24 hours.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Product & Operations
Redwood Inference
